changes.before: They retained P's successive-energy stop and an explicit iteration cap; the supplied approved findings do not specify the cap's numerical value.
changes.after: They retained P's successive-energy stop and, for this retained comparison implementation, imposed a cap of 80 iterations. This cap is not asserted to be part of P's authors' original protocol.

findings.quote: Contradicted by the approved retained ada/adapt_qsci/run.py: cap=80, range(cap), and max_iterations=cap specify the numerical iteration cap. Mandatory replacement: state that the cap was 80 iterations.
